create_dataset_processor: create a BaseProcessor subclass to download and process a new dataset for edit evaluation
run_core_processing: run core_processing on a BaseProcessor to standardize dataset splits, features, and normalize data
parse_json_to_dataset: parse a JSONL file into a DatasetDict using ExternalProcessor.parse_from_json with split column names
normalize_dataset_text: normalize input and edit text fields in a dataset split using the _normalize_data method
review_base_processor_class: review the BaseProcessor class and its abstract download_and_process method for dataset standardization
